title: UK > GERMANY?
subtitle: Population in millions; UN projection after 2023

lines.say: Today, Germany has 84 million people. The UK, just under 70 million.
On the United Nations' central projection, Germany starts shrinking, and the UK keeps growing.
In 2059, the lines cross, at about 76 million each.
Germany has more immigrants, but more deaths than births. A projection, not a promise. Our full video explains why the lines bend.
